name: hasTex2
meaning: 1 once Weather_SetTexture2 has set the second texture (0x52e615); the ctor clears it

name: centre
meaning: camera-space centre of the particle volume: (0, 0, sqrt(radius^2 - halfWidth^2) + near plane) (Weather_SetVolume 0x52e2a2-0x52e2dc)

name: count
meaning: live particles, capped at 500 by Weather_SetVolume (0x52e2ee)

name: vb
meaning: D3DFVF_XYZ vertex buffer, 4 vertices per particle (Weather_CreateVertexBuffers 0x531a08)

name: poly
meaning: the one triangle every quad half is pushed through (RenderPoly_Ctor 0x52e223)
